g.text: Each run starts once the CPU probe has come back to 60 °C, and the four runs alternate cng/isal/isal/cng so neither backend gets
the cold machine twice. The load is one ssh connection fed from memory — no disk, no rsync — so the cipher is what is being measured.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W), Balanced power plan · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U · Thunderbolt, MTU 65330, 20 Gbit/s
rsync 3.5.0 Windows port, github.com/nuket/rsync-windows · one ssh connection, aes128-gcm, fed from memory · ISA-L 2.26.1, six files, AVX2 path only · © 2026 Max Vilimpoc
